'If you configure your VPC so that model containers don't have access to the internet, they can't connect to the Amazon S3 buckets that contain your data unless you create a VPC endpoint that allows access'; creating the S3 endpoint adds a route to the chosen route tables; a custom endpoint policy can restrict access; at least two subnets in different Availability Zones are required. The CloudWatch log text in the case is an authored rendering, not quoted.

brief.situation: You are the ML engineer at Tarnwell Bank. Security requires the new card-fraud model's SageMaker AI endpoint to run in the private ml-vpc, which has no internet gateway and no NAT. The endpoint fraud-v3 has been Creating for 40 minutes and then fails. The model artifact is in s3://tarnwell-ml-models/fraud-v3/model.tar.gz. Card authorization switches to the new model at 10:30.
handover: The model is configured with VpcConfig: two private subnets in different Availability Zones and sg-ml-endpoint.
The previous model ran outside a VPC.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the diagram shows the endpoint's containers in the private subnets, the S3 bucket holding the model artifact, and the paths between them.
Each command takes a minute or two; the clock moves only when you act or wait.
When you close, you write the record and explain your reasoning.

writeup.question: For the record: why the endpoint failed, what you changed, and how future VPC deployments avoid it.

parts.label: Why
parts.modelAnswer: fraud-v3 runs in ml-vpc, which has no internet gateway, NAT or S3 endpoint; the containers could not download model.tar.gz from S3 and creation failed. The bucket policy was fine.

parts.label: Changed
parts.modelAnswer: A gateway endpoint for S3 on the private route tables, limited to the model bucket, then the endpoint recreated; it came up and scored a test transaction. An internet gateway breaks the isolation; a larger instance has the same network.

parts.label: Future
parts.modelAnswer: The VPC template includes the endpoint, and deployment checks S3 reachability before creating an endpoint.

exposedEndpoint.headline: Give the VPC a private path to S3
exposedEndpoint.body: A gateway endpoint gives private subnets a route to S3 without any internet path. Adding an internet gateway solves the download by giving up isolation.

switchCancelled.headline: No internet, no S3, unless you add an endpoint

scoring.modelReasoning: The endpoint fails while downloading its model, and ml-vpc has no internet gateway, no NAT and no S3 endpoint, so its containers have no path to S3. Create an S3 gateway endpoint on the private route tables with a policy for the model bucket, recreate the endpoint and score a test transaction. An internet gateway gives up the isolation security required; a larger instance changes nothing. Then put the endpoint in the VPC template.
